title: Contrast of an amplifier chain
summary: A 300 fs, 5 mJ pulse through a stretcher, an uncoated window and a Kerr medium: the window's ghost (relative intensity 1.1e-3, 29 ps after the main pulse) becomes a pre-pulse at -30.6 dB after compression (post-pulse -26.6 dB), and the pre-pulse worsens by 20 dB per decade of energy above 1 mJ.
